sentences.en: The soldier was wounded in the leg and couldn't move.
sentences.zh: 这个士兵腿部受伤无法移动。

sentences.en: The soldier carried on as if his wound was nothing.
sentences.zh: 尽管受了伤，那个士兵还是继续前进，好像伤口根本不算什么。

sentences.en: The man was used to treating this kind of wound.
sentences.zh: 这个人习惯于处理这种类型的伤口。
